sources.snippet: Model Introduction Hy-MT2 is a family of "fast-thinking" multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages.
